cards.Description: How many unused ketchup sachets are in your kitchen drawer right now?
cards.note: New card (debate): A fun household-clutter count about a different object from the 'bag of bags' card. No duplicate.

cards.Description: How many homes did your family send iftari to last Ramadan?
cards.note: New card (debate): Common Ramadan custom of sharing food with neighbours. The deck has iftar-eating cards but none about sending iftari. Anyone can answer, including 0.

cards.Description: How old were you when you kept your first full roza?
cards.note: New card (debate): Well-known family memory with a clear numeric answer. No roza-age card exists in the deck, and 'full' separates it from the half-day fasts children keep.

cards.Description: How likely are you to grab the seat closest to the heater at a family gathering in winter?
cards.note: New card (debate): Relatable, clean 0 to 100 question about gathering behaviour. The deck has no heater card.

cards.Description: How many relatives have told you which career you should choose?
cards.note: New card (debate): Well-known desi family in-joke with a valid count answer. Not in the deck.
